page_title: BOC 3-1 WOL | Bochum v Wolfsburg 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Robert Schroder has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Kevin Paredes just over the bar.
90+7' The corner from Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by the defence.
90+6' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and Wolfsburg manage to earn a corner.
90+3' Robert Schroder shows a yellow card to Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) for his blatant foul.

90+1' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' 3 - 1 Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) is released by Moritz-Broni Kwarteng, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) was quite harsh and Robert Schroder didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
84' Some great play by Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Koen Casteels sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
82' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
81' Substitution. Cristian Gamboa walks off the pitch and Tim Oermann (Bochum) comes on as a substitute.
81' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) has tested the patience of referee Robert Schroder and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
80' Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
79' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.
78' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

78' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Manuel Riemann shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolfsburg.
77' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
77' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) commits a rough challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul. Wolfsburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
76' It will be a substitution. Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Vaclav Cerny walks off.
76' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) replacing Rogerio.
76' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Manuel Riemann, who pulls off a decent save!
72' Thomas Letsch has decided to substitute Matus Bero and he is replaced by Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum).
72' The game has come to an end for Takuma Asano. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum).
72' Bernardo (Bochum) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar.
72' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
71' Koen Casteels comes off his line to intercept the corner from Maximilian Wittek (Bochum). The ball goes behind for a corner. Bochum will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' A quickly taken corner by Bochum.

70' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Takuma Asano (Bochum). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Good work from Bochum as they win a corner.
70' The free kick into the penalty area from Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
68' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
67' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
67' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
66' Referee Robert Schroder makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
66' Bernardo (Bochum) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
65' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolfsburg.
63' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Lovro Majer will be replaced by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
63' Substitution. Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Vaclav Cerny walks off.
62' Takuma Asano (Bochum) is cautioned by the referee.
62' Matus Bero (Bochum) sprays a pass out to Moritz Broschinski, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
60' Here is a change. Kevin Stoger is going off and Thomas Letsch gives the last tactical orders to Maximilian Wittek (Bochum).
59' Substitution. Philipp Hofmann leaves the pitch and is replaced by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
59' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Koen Casteels.
57' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
53' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
51' Takuma Asano (Bochum) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
49' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) sends an accurate short pass. Ridle Baku controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
46' Referee Robert Schroder blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Robert Schroder shows a yellow card to Kevin Stoger (Bochum) for his blatant foul.

45+1' 2 - 1 Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) bursts into the box after a great solo run and gets one-on-one with the keeper, who he neatly side steps and rolls the ball into an empty net. Wonderful effort!
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) and Vaclav Cerny combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.

39' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Bernardo (Bochum) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the left post. 2:0.
39' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
39' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Bochum earn a corner.
38' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) wastes a promising chance as he unleashes a first-time shot from mid-range which hits the left post!
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matus Bero (Bochum) was quite harsh and Robert Schroder didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Manuel Riemann intercepts the ball.
32' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
32' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Wolfsburg.

30' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) attempts a header from outside the box after the free kick. It was too far from goal and failed to cause any serious trouble for Koen Casteels, who made a comfortable save. The score remains the same.
29' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) will take the free kick.
29' Robert Schroder couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) and blew his whistle. Bochum will take a free kick near the side line.
26' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

24' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Manuel Riemann, who pulls off a stunning save!
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.
23' The ball is cleared after Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Wolfsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
21' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Schroder had an easy-decision to make.

19' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Koen Casteels. 1:0.
18' The linesman makes the right call and Bochum will have a corner.

17' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is out of play. Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
12' Takuma Asano (Bochum) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bochum are taking a throw-in.
11' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
7' Takuma Asano (Bochum) is flagged for offside.
6' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
4' Wolfsburg keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Bochum will take the kick-off.
Robert Schroder is introduced as the referee for today's match.
